By inclusion-exclusion over the three row-all-head events:
\[
|A|=\binom31 2^6-\binom32 2^3+\binom33=192-24+1=169.
\]
By symmetry, \(|B|=169\).

A row all heads and a column all tails cannot both occur, since their intersection cell would need to be both heads and tails. Thus \(|A\cap B|=0\).

So the number of valid grids is
\[
512-169-169=174.
\]
Thus
\[
p=\frac{174}{512}=\frac{87}{256}.
\]
Therefore,
\[
100a+b=100(87)+256=8956.
\]

\boxed{8956}
